summary: Iteration 3 tested: TS compile fix, forgot password (backend+UI), welcome screen + 5% first-request discount (backend+UI), admin quote with discount (backend maths + editor UI), job notices emails (admin + worker + avisos_cliente toggle), Admin › Configuración 'Clientes' section, UI standardisation spot-check at 390x844, regressions. Backend: new test_iteration3_features.py 10/10 pass (1 flaky run caused by changing egress IP), regression test_account_auth.py 16/16 and test_gmconecta_api.py 26/26 pass. Frontend: all requested flows work end-to-end (register → /bienvenida once → request form banner/summary/confirmation/Mis solicitudes badge; forgot password with all validations, wrong code error, correct injected code signs in and new password works; admin PIN, solicitud welcome note, quote editor prefilled 5% with Importe/Descuento/Base/IVA/Total, save; config validation + notices switch toasts; sign-out). Found 1 security issue (X-Forwarded-For spoofing bypasses all rate limits) and some minor UX issues. No deprecated Expo packages detected; no SafeAreaView-from-react-native issues detected.

critical.issue: client_ip() trusts the FIRST X-Forwarded-For value, which the client controls. Verified: POST /api/cuenta/recuperar with header 'X-Forwarded-For: 1.2.3.4' created limit key 'recuperar-ip:1.2.3.4'. An attacker can rotate this header to bypass the per-IP limits (recuperar 10/IP, registro 10/IP, PIN 5/IP lockout). Use the last (ingress-appended) hop or the right-most untrusted IP instead.

minor.issue: Welcome discount 'primera' check (find_one then insert) is not atomic: two concurrent first requests from the same account can both get descuento_bienvenida=5.

Default True means accounts created before this feature (no field in Mongo) will also be sent to the welcome screen on next login; confirm this is intended (they also get the 5% if they never made a request).

ui_bugs.issue: After a validation error (e.g. discount 51) the user corrects the value back to the saved value (5): the save button becomes disabled (form not dirty) and the red error 'El descuento de bienvenida debe estar entre 0 y 50%' stays on screen forever. Clear the error when the form changes / when it equals the saved values.

markWelcomeSeen() is only called by welcome-request-button / welcome-explore-button. Leaving /bienvenida with Android hardware back / iOS swipe-back does not mark it seen, so the welcome screen appears again on the next app launch. Call it on mount (or in a useEffect cleanup).

issues: Accesos rápidos labels truncated with ellipsis: 'Presupues…', 'Trabajador…', 'Configurac…'; KPI 'Rentabilidad …' also truncated. Reduce font size / allow 2 lines / shorter labels.

action_items: HIGH: fix core.client_ip to not trust the client-supplied first X-Forwarded-For entry (rate-limit bypass for PIN, login, registro, recuperar).
Admin › Configuración: clear settings-error when the form changes (stale error + disabled save button).
bienvenida.tsx: mark the welcome as seen on mount/unmount so back-gesture exits don't re-show it.
Admin dashboard quick-access tiles: avoid truncated labels at 390px.
Optional: make the first-request discount assignment atomic; confirm legacy accounts should see the welcome screen.
critical_code_review_comments: admin_routes.py is 1142 lines (>700) – split into modules (quotes, obras, finanzas, config).

Password reset: code hashed (sha256 email:code), attempts capped at 5, sessions revoked, reset doc deleted, response identical for unknown emails – good. cuerpo stored in messages does not contain the code – verified.

avisos.py: emails sent in background with deep copy and exception swallowing – saving obra never fails; verified sequence planificada → comenzado → 50 % → pausa → Retomamos → terminado (6 mails, no repeats).
Quote maths verified: 3×10.33 + 99.99 = 130.98, 5% = 6.55, base 124.43, total = base + round(base×21%,2).

success_rate.backend: 100% (52/52 incl. regression; 1 flaky per-IP rate-limit run due to egress IP change)
success_rate.frontend: 100% of requested flows pass; 2 minor UX bugs + 1 design issue

All staff profiles unlinked (note: admin profile was linked to audit.adm6484@example.com before testing – unlinked via cleanup_accounts.py as instructed). context_for_next_testing_agent: Run pytest -n 0 from /app/backend/tests; test_iteration3_features.py unlinks admin/tr01 (users.code is lowercase 'tr01') itself and clears registro:/recuperar login_limits (signup limit 10/IP/15min is easily hit). Egress IP of the test container can change between requests (two IPs seen), so per-IP limit tests may be flaky. PIN input does not always auto-submit – click pin-submit-button. Admin screens redirect to home if staff session missing.
rca_of_issue: Rate-limit bypass: core.py:489 client_ip returns request.headers['x-forwarded-for'].split(',')[0] – the left-most value is whatever the client sent; ingress appends the real IP at the end. Repro: curl -H 'X-Forwarded-For: 1.2.3.4' POST /api/cuenta/recuperar → db.login_limits key 'recuperar-ip:1.2.3.4'. Mitigation: take the right-most entry (or the one before the trusted proxy count).
